errors.evidence: The pie chart visually shows only three sectors (blue, red, orange). The legend lists five categories. Stating there are four sectors is incorrect.
The color of the third sector, representing 'Не съм сигурен', is orange, not yellow.
There is no visible purple sector in the pie chart. The description hallucinates its existence.
According to the legend, the purple color corresponds to 'Изобщо не съм съгласен' (Completely disagree), not 'Не съм съгласен' (Disagree), which is associated with the color green.
The value 0.1% is not written anywhere on the chart. It is an inference based on the sum of the other percentages and is presented as a fact from the chart.

errors.text_span: се приема, че е включван в останалите отговори
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect interpretation of why a sector is not visually represented. A value of 0% or a very small percentage does not mean it is 'included in the other answers'.

errors.text_span: а останалите следват по часовниковата стрелка
errors.evidence: Starting from the largest sector at the bottom (blue), the other sectors follow in a counter-clockwise direction (blue -> red -> orange), not clockwise.
